negative_invariants.description: Anthropic API key value MUST NOT appear in any stdout, stderr, log file, finding evidence, error message, or environment variable visible to subsequent processes (spec C-005, SC-007).
negative_invariants.verification_method: Sentinel-grep test in tests/security/test_anthropic_verify_output.py runs verifier against 5 scenarios with a known sentinel key value; asserts the sentinel never appears in captured stdout/stderr. Finding.__post_init__ refuses construction of any Finding containing a key-shaped substring.
negative_invariants.notes: Covers all 6 finding types and both check + repair output paths.

negative_invariants.description: anthropic-verify --check MUST NOT mutate any filesystem state (spec NFR-003, C-002).
negative_invariants.verification_method: Filesystem-snapshot test in tests/security/test_anthropic_verify_output.py snapshots tmp_path recursively before and after run_check; asserts equality across healthy and shadow fixtures.

negative_invariants.description: The verifier MUST NOT call openclaw doctor --fix (spec C-004 — that is the upstream source of shadow rows).
negative_invariants.verification_method: grep for 'doctor --fix' in scripts/security/anthropic_verify/ returns no production calls (anthropic-rotate.sh --rollback DOES call it, which is correct per FR-014 rollback semantics).
negative_invariants.notes: Verifier strictly avoids the upstream gap path.

negative_invariants.description: --repair mutations MUST be preceded by a .pre-repair.<ts>.bak backup (spec FR-008, NFR-004).
negative_invariants.verification_method: tests/security/test_anthropic_verify_repair.py backup-before-mutate test monkey-patches sqlite3.connect to raise after backup is written; asserts backup file exists and source SQLite is unchanged.
